description:
Every quick-add chip (FuelPanel.tsx:165-171) logs exactly one fixed portion. Two chicken breasts means tapping twice; half a shake is impossible.

MacroFactor's logging is ~1.5x fewer actions than MyFitnessPal's largely because quantity is part of the add, not a second trip. Give each chip a long-press / expand that reveals x0.5 x1 x1.5 x2 and a free multiplier, then scale proteinG and calories on the client before POST. No schema change: the entry still stores absolute grams and kcal, and the label carries the portion ("Chicken breast x2").

Depends on nothing. Touches apps/web/src/screens/start/FuelPanel.tsx only.
title: Log a quick-add at a chosen portion instead of one fixed serving
